title: I love this vacuum. It works really well
text: I love this vacuum. It works really well. Although, the price on these cordless vacuums are high, they really have great suction power.  They clean well and I would buy again, preferably at a lower price.  Easy to empty the dust bin.

product_metadata.title: Shark Stick Vacuum, Black
features: Powerful cordless suction for everyday dirt, debris, and high-traffic areas
Up to 40 minutes of runtime in handheld vacuum power mode. Includes a removable battery, which can be charged in or out of the cordless vacuum.
DuoClean Technology invented for fine dust and large debris on carpets and hard floors. One powerhead, two brushrolls.
Up to 30 minutes of runtime for hard floor cleaning and 25 minutes of runtime for carpet cleaning in ION Power mode.
Transforms to a hand vacuum for lightweight handheld cleaning in hard-to-reach places, above the floor, and in the car.
description: SharkNinja X40 Lightweight Cordless Hand Vacuum Mode, DuoClean for Carpet & Hardfloor Cleaning, and a Shark ION Battery (IR141)
